message: `curl ... | sh` runs code fetched from the network without anyone reading it; download to a file and review it first
help: download the script to a file outside kapsel (it has no network built-in in v0.3), read it with `cat install.sh`, and run it only as a reviewed, checked script: `kapsel install.sh`
notes: piping the network into an interpreter runs code nobody reviewed, with the session's grants
